page_title: GET 2-1 GIR | Getafe v Girona 31/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Beek D. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+8' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Daley Blind (Girona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Sanchez had an easy-decision to make.
90+4' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Cristhian Stuani (Girona) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper David Soria no chance!
90+4' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is going to take the penalty!
90+4' Referee Jose Sanchez awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
90+2' There's a break in play and referee Jose Sanchez must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Girona using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+1' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to substitute Adrian Liso and he is replaced by Yvan Neyou (Getafe).
90+1' It's time for a substitution. Abu Kamara (Getafe) comes on in place of Luis Milla.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' PENALTY APPEAL by Girona, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
86' 2 - 0 Borja Mayoral (Getafe) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and fires the ball inside the right post. What a wonderful strike!
86' Getafe failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
83' Adrian Liso (Getafe) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
82' Bryan Gil (Girona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jose Sanchez blows for a foul.
78' Thomas Lemar (Girona) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
77' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
76' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hugo Rincon (Girona) replacing Arnau Martinez.
76' The substitution is prepared. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ivan Martin.
72' 1 - 0 Mario Martin (Getafe) celebrates a beautiful goal. He wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and plants a header inside the left post. 1:0.
71' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Sanchez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
70' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
66' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
62' Luis Milla (Getafe) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
61' Bryan Gil (Girona) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Sanchez interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
59' Michel decides to make a substitution. Viktor Tsygankov will be replaced by Thomas Lemar (Girona).
59' Substitution. Bryan Gil (Girona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Joel Roca walks off.
51' Getafe work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
50' The resulting set piece from Getafe is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
48' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
47' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.
47' Paulo Gazzaniga pulls off a great save to deny Mauro Arambarri (Getafe), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez makes a switch. Abdel Abqar is coming on in place of Djene (Getafe) at the start of the second period.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has made a change at the break. Alex Sancris has come on in place of Coba da Costa (Getafe).
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez makes a half-time substitution. Mario Martin comes on in place of Kiko Femenia (Getafe).
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
42' 11:3 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
36' Jose Sanchez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Borja Mayoral (Getafe) and blew his whistle.

34' Coba da Costa (Getafe) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jose Sanchez with no other option than to blow for a foul.
29' The goalkeeper makes a nice save to avert the danger from the free kick, which was executed by Viktor Tsygankov (Girona).
28' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle after Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. A free kick to Girona.
25' The Girona players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
23' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
22' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

21' What a sweet touch by Joel Roca (Girona) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot which goes towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to thwart him! Now Girona have a corner.
18' A pass by Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
17' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
16' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
12' Luis Milla (Getafe) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
9' Joel Roca (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
6' Getafe are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

2' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez plays a lofted ball in from the by-line towards Coba da Costa (Getafe), who places his header from near the edge of the six-yard box well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
2' Rough tackle by Vladyslav Vanat (Girona). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Getafe will have the kick-off.
Jose Sanchez is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups In the details of this match, you can glance at the lineups while the game is about to begin.
